ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dark-grey pixels dominate approximately 85% of the fluke surface, with high-intensity white pixels accounting for the remaining 15% in concentrated regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips (outermost points) of both lobes and along the trailing edge periphery. The central and proximal regions are composed of contiguous low-intensity dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetric V-shaped notch at the central axis with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays high-frequency, irregular serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude peaks (spikes) compared to the more rounded, lower-amplitude variations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges (proximal margins) exhibit a smooth convex curvature extending from the base to the tips. Trailing edges exhibit a concave trajectory as they descend toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters with roughly circular geometry located at the distal-most tips of both lobes; scattered circular micro-anomalies present along the medial-right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Notable long diagonal linear scar on the left lobe originating from the inner-proximal region toward the outer-distal edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional rake marks across both lobes; significant white scarring/depigmentation on both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast white patch is visible on the proximal-left margin near the junction of the fluke and peduncle.
